summary: Iter-9 validated the new spec (derived formato, computed pacchetto price, no vie/indirizzo/formato manual fields, Aree OSP Progetto Speciale + shared zone, /comune/profilo & PATCH canone removed, soggetti creativity flow at campaign level). Backend: 14/14 new tests PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py). Frontend: comune UI (impianti/pacchetti/zone/spazi) matches spec (no removed inputs, filtri present, dynamic prezzo totale updates 0 -> 430 as impianti are checked), no link-profilo in sidebar, /comune/profilo route renders no page. User creatività flow: soggetti-panel with 5 formato blocks (Circuito EUR 5), file upload with NO prompt/confirm dialogs, filename+delete visible, per-impianto assegna select lists ONLY matching-formato soggetti, riepilogo 'X/Y impianti assegnati' updates correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BackofficeLayout.jsx still imports/maps `Settings` icon to key 'link-profilo' (line 13) even though the link is not in NAV array anymore — dead reference. Harmless but should be pruned.

test_ooh_flow.py (previous iteration file) still exercises the OLD /creativita library endpoint (removed) — running it now fails on TestOOHCompletion.test_full_flow. Suggest updating or gating that suite; the new test_new_features.py fully covers the new soggetti flow.

ooh.py `crea_soggetto` accepts arbitrary `formato` string but does not verify it belongs to the campagna's formati set — a malicious client could POST a formato that doesn't exist in this campaign; the mismatch check on assign still prevents damage, but adding a check `if formato not in {i['formato'] for pratica.impianti}` would fail-fast.
server.py SpazioIn still exposes `zona` (free-text) field alongside `zona_id`; the frontend uses `zona_id` only — the legacy `zona` string can now go stale. Consider deprecating.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for spec areas tested (comune impianti/pacchetti/zone/spazi + user creativita UI)

test_credentials: user@demo.it, comune.l3@demo.it, comune@demo.it — all demo123. Used successfully.
